claim: If and only if the final qualification record is PASS and both the specification lock and full qualification lock verify, WP1-CAT-N3BP-v1 qualifies the declared native correction-and-continuation path to generate a 169-member catalogue of one connected planar bABabaBAba Newtonian three-body family on the frozen two-dimensional mass grid. Every member is stored in the qualified full 18-dimensional barycentric inertial state contract, closes over one corrected period, carries bounded invariant and reduced-planar Floquet diagnostics, and is evaluated one-to-one at the same masses against the pinned Li-Li-Liao/SJTU catalogue without using those evaluation rows as continuation seeds.
evidence_boundary: Generation starts from one explicitly disclosed rounded equal-mass root published by Li, Li, and Liao; v1 therefore qualifies native correction, two-parameter continuation, full-state catalogue production, and external family-surface conformance, not independent discovery of the root. The external table is public and the holdout is execution-reserved rather than blind. The claim excludes other topologies or disconnected families, spatial orbit generation, relative-periodic orbits, collision passage, folds or bifurcations, pseudo-arclength continuation, nonlinear or spatial stability, completeness, arbitrary masses or scale, and a general production catalogue for the full three-body problem.

model.equations: Unsoftened Newtonian three-body equations with G=1 and three finite positive masses.
model.family: The connected planar family identified by the source free-group word bABabaBAba.
model.masses: m3=1; m1 and m2 independently take 13 values from 0.970 through 1.030 in increments of 0.005.
model.equivalence: Translation and boost are fixed barycentrically; rotation, scale, phase, and body labels are fixed by the canonical section. Distinct mass triples are distinct catalogue models and are never deduplicated against one another.
model.periodicity: Inertial periodicity of the complete labelled 18D state after one positive physical period; relative periodicity is out of scope.

published_root.provenance: Rounded from Li, Li, and Liao, arXiv:2007.10184; the exact SJTU row is excluded from external qualification metrics.

generation.predictor: Secant prediction in (x1,v1,v2,T) after the first corrected step in each signed mass direction.
generation.corrector: Damped nonlinear least squares on the complete planar one-period closure residual, with fixed masses and canonical section.
generation.external_data_policy: The generator API accepts no external catalogue. Only the disclosed root constants may enter generation. Candidate payload and provenance are frozen before any split evaluation is accepted.

stability.method: Integrate the analytic planar inertial variational equations, project the 12D STM to the canonical 8D translation quotient, and apply the Kapela-Simo trace/minor criterion used by the source to the nontrivial reciprocal pairs.
stability.qualified_label: Planar linear S/U only. Out-of-plane multipliers are reported but not qualified.

external_source.eligible_rows: Exact mass matches on the 13x13 output grid, excluding the disclosed (1,1,1) root row.
external_source.matching: One native candidate to one external row at identical ordered masses; nearest-neighbour reuse and source-seeded correction are prohibited.
external_source.split_policy: Deterministic salted stratification by source S/U label into development, calibration, and execution-reserved holdout after candidate freeze.
external_source.holdout_classification: Public, disjoint, execution-reserved evidence; not custodian-blind.

execution.holdout_rule: The holdout runner verifies both locks and every frozen hash, refuses an existing output, and evaluates the reserved rows exactly once.

invalidation: Any changed root, grid, family identity, section, corrector, continuation rule, stability rule, threshold, split, source hash, code path, prerequisite record, or post-lock decision input invalidates v1. A failed holdout remains FAIL and requires a new campaign version.
downstream_policy: A PASS supplies a bounded full-state periodic trajectory family for future WP2/WP3 experiments. It does not widen WP2's model qualification and must not be cited as evidence for catalogue completeness or root discovery.
